import re
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

now_dt = datetime.now()
month_entry = f"{now_dt.month:02d}/{(now_dt.year%100):02d}"
# recompute month_start/end for safety
month_start = f"{now_dt.year:04d}-{now_dt.month:02d}-01"
next_month = datetime(now_dt.year+1,1,1) if now_dt.month==12 else datetime(now_dt.year, now_dt.month+1, 1)
last_day = (next_month - timedelta(days=1)).day
month_end = f"{now_dt.year:04d}-{now_dt.month:02d}-{last_day:02d}"

# Fetch venmo sent transactions for this month
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
sent_txns = []
while True:
    resp = apis.venmo.show_transactions(access_token=venmo_token, direction='sent', min_created_at=month_start, max_created_at=month_end, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    batch = resp['transactions'] if isinstance(resp, dict) and 'transactions' in resp else resp
    if not batch:
        break
    sent_txns.extend(batch)
    if len(batch) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1

expense_total = sum([t.get('amount',0.0) for t in sent_txns])
correct_line = f"- {month_entry} => ${expense_total}"
wrong_line = f"- {month_entry} => $None"

# Read current note content (from earlier may be stale, so get fresh once before update)
note_id = 3084
note_resp = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=note_id, access_token=simple_note_token)
content = note_resp.get('content','')

print('month_entry', month_entry)
print('expense_total', expense_total)
print('wrong_line_present_before', wrong_line in content)
print('correct_line_present_before', correct_line in content)

# Replace wrong line with correct line; if wrong line not present, append correct line.
if wrong_line in content:
    new_content = content.replace(wrong_line, correct_line)
else:
    # Append as new entry at end with newline separation if needed
    if content and not content.endswith('\n'):
        new_content = content + '\n'
    new_content = new_content + '\n' + correct_line if new_content.strip().endswith('') else new_content + correct_line

# Ensure no remaining $None for this month
new_content_check = ('$None' in new_content)
print('wrong_line_present_after_replace', wrong_line in new_content)
print('contains_$None_after', new_content_check)
print('new_content_preview')
print(new_content[-300:])

# Update note with corrected content
update_resp = apis.simple_note.update_note(note_id=note_id, access_token=simple_note_token, content=new_content)
print('update_resp', update_resp)

# Verification (single read)
verify_resp = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=note_id, access_token=simple_note_token)
verify_content = verify_resp.get('content','')
print('wrong_line_present_after', wrong_line in verify_content)
print('correct_line_present_after', correct_line in verify_content)
print('verify_tail')
print(verify_content[-300:])
